observations.validSignIn: The legacy runner submitted the rendered sign-in form and recorded arrival at /en/overview after 2445 ms. Its only retained sign-in-step screenshot was captured after redirect.
observations.invalidCorrection: The legacy UX verdict states that a deliberately wrong sign-in value was refused, both entered values survived, correction occurred at the same field, and the terminal frame returned 308 ms later. It did not retain transport, cookie, or authenticated-state proof for that refusal.
observations.reloadSession: The legacy UX verdict states that Back returned the overview with values, reload retained the overview and balance, and a fresh profile that had never signed in landed on the sign-in surface. It did not inspect refresh-cookie exchange, client storage, or an expired-session branch.

excluded: all secret values and browser/session material
